title: M11 Wave 1: c1/06 multiply and c1/07 a-rule-for-x, with G2 and G1
description: Part of M11 (SIE-e8c918). Lessons: c1/06 multiply (a card multiplies two boxes; widget: box picker). c1/07 a-rule-for-x (a list of cards is a rule f(x)=x*x+1; table ask for x=1,2,3; predict f(4)=17). Engine: G2 (most important), G1. Decision: functions before binary. A lesson that adds a widget teaches no new math idea.
right_now_summary: This issue defines two lessons on multiplication and function rules, prioritizing the G2 and G1 engines.
